'''Skarpos''' was a barbaric [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] that was under the sway of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Malakite]]. It was a stormy planet with many trenches, and a forbidding-looking mesa. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the planet was invaded and occupied by rival Sith Lord [[Odion]]'s [[Odionate]] military forces. Later, Aunt [[Zoojoo]] revealed to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] that Skarpos was the location of the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact created prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] which was the target of Odion's [[Project Pandemonium]]. Disguised as a [[Novitiate]] named "Mercy", Kerra and the other Novitiates returned to Skarpos and were immediately besieged by Malakite's reinforcements and Sith Lord [[Daiman]]'s forces.
